answer.reason: Based on BLS QCEW estimates, Idaho’s private-sector construction employment for December 2024 was approximately 68,871 covered jobs.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Idaho, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 68,871 covered jobs
B. 52,471 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Idaho statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/16000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
